shared_with: Doc 15 (metric dictionary) — §21: "share golden lifecycle fixtures with Doc 15 from day one; metric disputes die when both sides run the same fixtures"
description: A deposit dispute travelling new -> open -> pending_internal -> open -> pending_customer -> open -> resolved -> auto-closed. Every hold is the time the ticket spent in the status it is LEAVING, which is what the FR-24 accumulators measure.

contract.hold_seconds: how long the ticket sat in its current status before this transition; the harness backdates last_status_changed_at by exactly this much through the platform role, because the app role cannot write that column (R-19b)
contract.accrues: which FR-24 accumulator the OLD status feeds: staff | customer | none
contract.tolerance_seconds: the harness's own runtime between backdating and transitioning; the accumulator may exceed the expected total by at most this, never fall below it

steps.why: FR-05: first assignment or first staff public reply claims it
US-02: waiting on the payments team
answered — the wait was the platform's, not the player's
staff needs the player's deposit reference
the player replied; this stretch is the ONLY one that is theirs
FR-07 auto-close after 48 h of silence; a resolved ticket waits on nobody
